message.content:
We can use the known integral:

∫ exp(x)*cos(x) dx = (1/2)*exp(x)*(sin(x)+cos(x))

Therefore:

∫ -2*exp(x)*cos(x) dx = -2*(1/2)*exp(x)*(sin(x)+cos(x)) + C

So the indefinite integral is:

<answer>-exp(x)*(sin(x)+cos(x)) + C</answer>
